QuestInfo.name: Fair Trade
QuestInfo.0: Grendel will help you if you help him. Might as well hear him out....
QuestInfo.1: You have to learn to control your darkness before it destroys you, and Grendel holds the key. Do as he asks and destroy #b50 Curse Eyes#k at Green Tree Trunk.

0.1: You think you're the first mage to ever dabble in Dark magic? Little matter. Let's channel some of that power of yours into something good, shall we?\r\n#L0##bVery well. But take care you do not forget your end of the agreement!#l\n#k
0.2: Of course. Now, what are you researching, exactly?\r\n#L0##bI wish to learn more about Dark magic and Aurora.#l\n#k
0.3: Very well. I've got a list of monsters I want you to hunt. I'll search the library while you're gone.

yes.0: Begin by hunting 50 Curse Eyes. It shouldn't be a problem.

no.0: If you don't like the deal, you're free to go. But if you harm anyone in town...

0.0: Let me guess. After you sent him away, you realized you couldn't bring him back. Is that right?\r\n#L0##b...How did you know?#l\n#k

mob.0: Just concentrate on holding up your end of the bargain.

1.0: The darkness within howls... Is it because I've been given such petty tasks?
